info.title: FleetIQ HTTP UI baseline
info.description: Backend-owned, versioned subset of the /api/v1 HTTP surface for asset identity and semantic metadata reads. Other implemented routes are intentionally not yet described here. Protected routes use configured workload bearer or provider-neutral OIDC browser sessions. Modes are mutually exclusive; every read checks current identity and tenant metadata.read policy.

get.summary: Discover the active API major version
List one authorized tenant's assets in stable ID order
get.description: The authenticated operator or configured workload identity must have current metadata.read access for the selected tenant. The route is absent without complete browser or workload identity configuration. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request snapshot.
Returns asset identity, its exact pinned asset-type version, and tenant-owned typed external identifiers. A missing asset returns 404.

get.summary: Read a bounded relationship snapshot involving one asset
get.description: The latest revision known at known_at_ms is selected, then tested at effective_at_ms. Results are bounded pages ordered by stable ID. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request database snapshot; repeat the same times and limit on the next page. Both directed source and target roles are returned. The asset must exist in the current catalogue; only edges are bitemporal.

get.summary: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot targeting one asset
get.description: The latest revision known at known_at_ms is selected, then tested at effective_at_ms. Results are bounded pages ordered by stable ID. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request database snapshot; repeat the same times and limit on the next page. The selected latest-known binding revision must target this asset. The asset must exist in the current catalogue.

get.summary: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot for one source signal
get.description: The latest revision known at known_at_ms is selected, then tested at effective_at_ms. Results are bounded pages ordered by stable ID. A cursor traversal is not a cross-request database snapshot; repeat the same times and limit on the next page. The exact device asset, endpoint, and signal tuple selects a source; an unregistered signal can validly return an empty page.
Read an exact immutable type version. Property references retain definition order and point to exact immutable versions.
Read the exact value kind and optional canonical unit; this endpoint performs no measurement conversion.
Returns the stable name of the exact immutable directed relationship type version.
Creates a short-lived bound OIDC authorization-code attempt. Browser identity must be configured. No request-selected issuer, client, callback, or return URL is supported.

Requires __Host-fleetiq-login from the initiating browser. Atomically consumes the matching state once before code exchange, validates signed provider identity and resolves a provisioned active actor. Provider roles or email never provision access.
Revalidates session expiry and the current external-identity mapping to the actor established at login. Returns no provider claims, tokens, or tenant grants.

post.description: Requires exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1. Deletes the stored session and browser-bound pending login attempts, then clears cookies; success is idempotent when no session is present. Existing in-flight reads may complete.

403.description: The configured Origin or X-FleetIQ-CSRF header is absent, duplicated, or invalid.

next_after.description: Exclusive cursor for the next page, or null when no next page exists.

authority.description: Optional issuing authority within this tenant-owned namespace.

value.description: External identifier value; no kind is assumed universal.

end_ms.description: Exclusive physical effective end; null means open-ended.

effective_at_ms.description: Physical time used for this page.

known_at_ms.description: Recorded-time cutoff used for this page.

RelationshipSnapshot.description: One bounded, bitemporal relationship page for an asset.

revision.description: Positive u64 revision serialized as decimal text to preserve JavaScript precision.

known-at-ms.description: Signed Unix milliseconds through which recorded revisions are known; a correction may change a later snapshot.

snapshot-limit.description: Maximum records returned on one page; defaults to 50.

relationship-after.name: after
relationship-after.description: Exclusive stable relationship ID cursor from next_after; repeat the same times and limit.

target-binding-asset-id.name: asset_id
target-binding-asset-id.description: Asset targeted by the selected bindings.

binding-after.name: after
binding-after.description: Exclusive stable binding ID cursor from next_after; repeat the same times and limit.

definition-version.name: version
definition-version.description: Exact immutable definition version; a positive u32 decimal integer.

oidc-code.name: code
oidc-code.description: Provider authorization code. Required on successful callback; omitted when the provider returns error.

oidc-state.name: state
oidc-state.description: Exact one-use authorization state bound to the login cookie in this browser.

oidc-error.name: error
oidc-error.description: Provider rejection. A valid bound login attempt is consumed before returning generic unauthorized.

browser-origin.name: Origin
browser-origin.description: Must exactly equal the configured HTTPS public UI/API origin. Missing, duplicate, null, and other origins are rejected.

browser-csrf.name: X-FleetIQ-CSRF
browser-csrf.description: Same-origin custom header; the server does not enable credentialed CORS. Duplicates are rejected.

getApiVersion-200.description: The active product API major version.

listAssets-200.description: Bounded asset summaries. An empty catalogue returns an empty array and a null cursor.

listAssetRelationships-200.description: Read a bounded relationship snapshot involving one asset

listAssetSignalBindings-200.description: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot targeting one asset

listSourceSignalBindings-200.description: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot for one source signal

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid path identifier, definition version, time, limit, cursor, or query.

Unauthenticated.description: The selected authentication mode rejected missing, invalid, expired, or unregistered credentials. WWW-Authenticate is emitted only for configured workload bearer mode.

Forbidden.description: The actor has no current metadata.read grant for this tenant.

NotFound.description: The authorized exact resource or required current asset is absent.

BrowserMethodNotAllowed.description: The method is unsupported for this browser authentication endpoint. Consult Allow for supported methods.

BrowserUnauthenticated.description: The browser credential or login attempt is absent, invalid, expired, or no longer registered. API reads do not redirect to sign-in.

getOperatorSession-200.description: The current authenticated operator session. No provider token, external subject, or tenant grant is returned.

beginOperatorLogin-303.description: A five-minute browser-bound login attempt was persisted. Navigate to the configured provider authorization URL.

Location.description: Configured HTTPS provider authorization URL with code flow, PKCE S256, state, and nonce.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/ cookies without Domain; callback may emit multiple Set-Cookie fields.

completeOperatorLogin-303.description: A registered operator authenticated. A fresh session replaces the previous credential; the login cookie is cleared.

Location.description: Fixed same-origin destination /, without user-selected return targets.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/ cookies without Domain; callback may emit multiple Set-Cookie fields.

endOperatorSession-204.description: The session was revoked if present, bound pending login attempts were removed, and both browser cookies were cleared. Logout is idempotent without a session.

cache-control.description: Protected responses are not stored by shared or browser caches.

referrer-policy.description: Authentication responses prevent authorization code or state disclosure through referrers.

bearerAuth.description: Current configured workload credential. A browser-safe identity flow is not available yet.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-fleetiq-session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, host-only session cookie. Available only in configured browser OIDC mode; workload bearer and browser modes are mutually exclusive.
